description: Submit a free South African Code 8 driving school callback lead on behalf of a learner or parent after the user has explicitly confirmed their details in chat. Pure lead enquiry with no online payment required.

booked_by_role.description: Who is enquiring: 'learner' (for themselves) or 'parent' (parent/sponsor enquiring on behalf of child/student)

city.description: City or town for pickup and DLTC testing (e.g., 'Pretoria', 'Centurion', 'Midrand')

email.description: Optional email address for a written package quote

learner_name.description: Child or student full name (required when booked_by_role is 'parent')

learner_phone.description: Optional 10-digit South African mobile number for the student's lesson pickup coordination

name.description: Learner/student full name (required for learner mode; also used as student name if learner_name omitted in parent mode)

notes.description: Optional scheduling or pickup notes such as preferred days, school gate, or target test date (max 300 chars)

package_interest.description: Selected package: 'practical_lessons' (R1,900-R5,500 Practical Lessons + Test Car Hire) or 'full_package' (R5,500-R6,500 Full Learner's + Driver's Package)

payer_email.description: Optional parent/sponsor email address for written quote copy

payer_name.description: Parent or sponsor full name (required when booked_by_role is 'parent')

payer_phone.description: Parent or sponsor 10-digit South African WhatsApp/mobile number (required when booked_by_role is 'parent')

phone.description: 10-digit South African mobile/WhatsApp number (e.g., '0721234567' or '+27721234567'); required for learner mode

suburb.description: Exact suburb or area for door-to-door pickup (e.g., 'Waterkloof', 'Montana', 'Irene', 'Waterfall')

user_confirmed_submission.description: Must be true ONLY after summarizing all collected details back to the user and receiving their explicit confirmation to submit the callback request.

name: request_driving_school_callback
